execution_policy.reason: The proposal defines benchmarking and calibration logic but does not acquire or process microscopy data.

research_brief.title: TraceRes: task-specific resolution passports for optical nanoscopy
research_brief.research_object: Resolution claims across optical microscopy modalities.
falsification_conditions: Typed claims do not reduce category errors.
The bound envelope does not improve calibration.
Audits do not reduce omitted alternatives.
Constrained modality selection does not improve valid-information yield.

template_routing.scope_assessment: low physical-execution risk; medium inference, reproducibility, and communication risk

data_plan.selection_rule: Use only human-approved public, synthetic, or calibration data with complete provenance and permission records.

steps: Pre-register task, thresholds, and hypothesis library.
Assess physical, statistical, sampling, labeling, and reconstruction alternatives.
Apply blinded truth-known or traceable calibration cases.
Compute task-specific metrics and assign bounded status.

risk_register.risk: A nominal resolution number is presented as biological structural truth.
risk_register.mitigation: Typed claim, error-bound envelope, and blinded calibration are mandatory.

risk_register.risk: Reconstruction prior or processing creates a visually compelling but unsupported feature.
risk_register.mitigation: Versioned pipeline, alternative-model sensitivity, and truth-known cases.

risk_register.risk: A physically valid calibration does not transfer to the sample of interest.
risk_register.mitigation: Restrict status scope and require sample-class-specific validation.

risk_register.risk: A proposed design is misconstrued as completed microscopy.
risk_register.mitigation: DESIGN_ONLY policy and empty observed_results field.
